✓ **Timing:** Meals spaced 3 hours apart; light pre-sleep snack aids overnight recovery

---

- Consume familiar foods only (all items tested during training)
- Final meal 3-4 hours before start time
- Race morning: Light toast with honey + water 1 hour before
